_comment: Declarative config for scripts/pkg-autoupdate.py. Each entry tells the updater how to detect and apply updates for one package in pkgs/. Edit an entry here to change behavior for that package — do NOT edit pkg-autoupdate.py. See docs/UPDATE-SAFETY.md for the safety process.

manual_only.hytale: No public GitHub releases endpoint (hytale-studios org returns no releases). Manual: check hytale.com/download for new launcher version, bump version + hash by hand.
manual_only.octarine: No upstream 'latest' symlink on CDN — URL embeds the version explicitly. Manual: see octarine.app/changelog, bump version + hash by hand.
manual_only.omniroute: Docker image requires content digest (not :latest tag) for reproducibility. Manual: sudo docker pull diegosouzapw/omniroute && sudo docker image ls --digests diegosouzapw/omniroute, then update imageDigest + sha256 by hand.
manual_only.net-report: Local source (./.) — your own code. Updates come from git commits in this repo, not from upstream.

macrotool-gtk4.note: YOUR OWN REPO — auto-bumping is safe. cargoHash will be left as the lib placeholder ('') so nix re-fetches + recomputes; build verifies the new hash.

orbolay.note: Skia binaries version 0.98.0 is pinned separately in src/default.nix and is NOT bumped automatically. Only rev + src hash + cargoHash update.

fleet._comment: Per-host Netbird IPs (2026-08-11). Updates must be applied to every host that consumes pkgs/. Override via --hosts when running scripts/fleet-deploy.py manually.
fleet._deploy_order_note: uwu-phone deploys separately on mobile schedule (only when online + charging). Default order: server first (build host), then UwU, then TSBW. Phone skipped unless --include-phone.

safety_gates._comment: All gates must pass for a build to be considered deployable. Skipping any gate is logged + blocks the deploy.
safety_gates._rollback_note: If auto-deploy breaks a host, the rollback script uses git revert + the same NAR-roundtrip path to push the previous known-good generation to every fleet device.

cron._deliver_note: Result reports back to the chat that triggered this job — you can change to 'all' to fan out to discord/telegram/etc.
